mcq_fix.s: Debt Recovery Tribunals deal with debts due to banks and financial institutions above:

mcq_drop.why: vague/oddly worded ('indicated as the next step'); no fixed fact

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: enforcement/revenue agencies of GoI
wrong topic: Lok Adalats / legal services

patterns: APPSC asks only basic one-liners: IBC came into force in 2016; PCA is RBI action to check commercial banks against NPAs; PCA full form.
UPSC adds concept items (Interest Coverage Ratio, S4A, Inter-Creditor Agreement) and the insolvency vs bankruptcy definition swap.
App goes far deeper (SARFAESI section numbers, 2026 IBC amendment, NARCL guarantee terms, FY24 recovery shares) than any PYQ; acceptable but well beyond APPSC depth.
